Projects for herdr

Usage: herdr-projects [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  new              Create a project folder with its skeleton files
  list             List projects
  open             Open a project: its workspace, coordinator tab and coordinator agent
  context          Print the digest the coordinator reads at the start of every turn
  overview         Print threads grouped by what needs you
  focus            Show only one project's panes in the sidebar, sorted by attention
  unfocus          Clear the sidebar view (herdr holds one, so this clears any tool's view)
  inbox            Inbox items
  thread           Threads: the project's worker agents
  routine          Routines: scheduled prompts and watched commands
  pause            Pause a project: the ticker skips it and `thread start` is refused
  resume           Make a paused project active again
  archive          Archive a project: paused, hidden, tokens cleared, `open` refused
  unarchive        Make an archived project active again
  delete           Move a project folder to the trash (no worktree, branch or PR is touched)
  adopt-workspace  Continue the current workspace's agent pane as a new project
  safety           Safety settings
  skill            Print the coordinator skill
  doctor           Check the setup: versions, tools, root, ticker and each project's session
  ticker           The background ticker
  help             Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <DIR>  Projects root (default: $HERDR_PROJECTS_ROOT, then config.toml, then ~/.herdr-projects)
  -h, --help        Print help
  -V, --version     Print version
